tests.title: Initial load displays arcade menu with 4 mode cards
Audio toggle button flips mute state in state and localStorage
Selecting Mode 1 transitions scene to EGG_LAYING
Selecting Mode 2 transitions scene to MUDDY_PUDDLES
Selecting Mode 3 transitions scene to CHICK_MAZE
Selecting Mode 4 transitions scene to DADDY_PIG
Standalone index.html loads with zero 404 network requests and zero console errors
Spacebar triggers egg laying and records cluck and eggPop audio events
Mouse click / screen tap triggers egg laying
Eggs experience gravity and bounce with restitution on ground
Eggs stack when falling onto existing settled eggs
Reaching nest capacity triggers hatching state on settled eggs
Hatching egg progresses through cracking stages and emits crack/hatch audio events
Hatched baby chick scampers off-screen and is cleanly removed from entity pool
Puddles spawn dynamically over time with valid positions and sizes
Spacebar / tap initiates character jump with parabolic velocity curve
Landing inside a puddle creates splash particles and fires splash audio event
Center-hit landing grants bonus splash multiplier points
Landing on golden puddle awards +3s time extension
60-second timer decrements smoothly in real-time
Timer expiring at 0 triggers game over modal with score summary
Garden maze initializes with fence obstacles and wandering chicks
Clicking/tapping on garden grid drops a corn seed entity
Seed placement emits seedDrop audio chime
Nearby wandering chicks steer toward active corn seed
Chicks consume seed upon arrival, causing seed entity to disappear
Guiding chick into coop increments coopSavedCount and triggers cheer effect
Saving all required chicks completes stage and advances to next garden layout
Rapid tapping increments score and fills fever meter

Sustained rapid input triggers visual panic stages (sweat, shake, steam)
Fever decay occurs when tapping slows down
Reaching maximum frenzy / high score threshold triggers computer smoke particles
Humorous Computer Overheat / Blue Screen cutscene triggers with crash audio jingle
New high score is persisted to localStorage under hmc_game_data_v1
Burst spamming 50 taps/sec does not softlock or freeze canvas
Simultaneous multi-touch taps register without NaN coordinates
Rapid mode switching spam cleanly unmounts previous mode state
Continuous key holding does not flood runaway entities
Rapid mute button spamming maintains synchronized audio state
Ultra-wide desktop (21:9 / 3440x1440) maintains letterboxing
Ultra-narrow mobile portrait (9:16 / 375x812) scales down proportionally
High-DPI / Retina Screen (DPR = 3.0) internal buffer scaling
Dynamic orientation flip adapts canvas within 1 animation frame
Minimal dimension window (100x100) clamps without division by zero
100 SFX triggers in 1 second does not clip or exhaust voices
Background tab audio throttling / visibilitychange handling

Active voice count stays bounded during rapid gameplay
Chicks bumping into outer garden walls deflect without tunneling
Screen boundary clamping keeps all interactive entities in view
100% of spawned puddles lie within playable lawn bounds

Idle player in Mode 2 lets timer expire cleanly to Game Over
Extreme score value (999,999+) renders formatted without UI overflow

Infinity / NaN coordinate input sanitization guard

Muting audio during intense particle bursts preserves 60 FPS rendering
Keyboard + touch hybrid input simultaneously registers valid inputs

Chick Maze continuous drag pointer creates connected seed trail
AudioContext interrupted/suspended recovery resumes without exception
Beating high scores across 2 different modes sequentially updates storage
Rapid Game Over -> Restart loop (10 iterations) executes cleanly
